questions: Should the bar chart have labeled axes (x-axis: words, y-axis: frequency) and a title, or is a plain bar chart with no labels acceptable?
If there are ties in word frequency beyond the top 10, how should the selection among tied words be made (e.g., alphabetical order, arbitrary)?
Should the bar chart use a specific color, bar width, or orientation (vertical/horizontal)?
What punctuation characters should be removed? Only standard string.punctuation, or also other symbols like emojis or currency signs?
Should words be split on any whitespace (including tabs, newlines) or only spaces?
If the text contains fewer than 10 unique words, should the returned list have fewer than 10 tuples, or include zero-count placeholders?
Should the function close the matplotlib plot or leave it open for further modification?
If the text is empty, should the bar chart have any specific axis limits or tick marks?
